meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加一个网页监控面板:安装后,数据库快照每 60 秒、日志每 2 秒自动推送上去;浏览器里能看会话、token 用量、实时日志等监控页面。
howto.when: 当你说“给 NanoClaw 装监控面板/仪表板”,或希望查看它的会话、用量、实时日志时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控仪表板。
say.note: 会安装依赖、拷入推送器并自动接线。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 装好 dashboard 和实时日志。
给 NanoClaw 配上监控面板。

howto.what_en: Adds a local dashboard to NanoClaw, with a pusher sending DB snapshots every 60s and log lines every 2s. UI pages show sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, messages, and live logs.
howto.when_en: Takes effect when you ask Claude to install or enable a monitoring dashboard/panel for NanoClaw, for example to check sessions, usage, or real-time logs.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs dependencies, copies the pusher, and wires it up.

say_en.text: Set up the NanoClaw dashboard with live logs.
say_en.note: After restart, open localhost:3100 for logs and pages.
Can generate DASHBOARD_SECRET and set the port during setup.
